headline: Approved a minor field change at 135 Dodge Hill Rd., plus minutes from two earlier meetings.
summary: Consultant B. Faneuf recommended the change, which would include 5 trees, 3 shrubs, and boulders in place of cultecs. Updates covered enforcement cases at 72 Main Street, 320 Putnam Hill Road, and 126 Burbank Road, plus a forest management plan and a MassDOT invasives notice.
decisions: Approved a minor field change at 135 Dodge Hill Rd., 3-0, with W. Wence recused.

transcript:
# SUTTON CONSERVATION COMMISSION

## Meeting Minutes

September 2, 2026

Approved [signature]

Pursuant to Governor Healey's directive extending the temporary Open Meeting provisions until June 30, 2027, the Conservation Commission meeting will be conducted in a HYBRID format and will be recorded. *Recordings will be available on the Town's website and YouTube channel. *Please be aware: Participants attending via Zoom will have their video and audio disabled. *If you wish to engage in discussion, raise your hand; if acknowledged by the Chair, you will receive a pop-up message allowing you to unmute yourself. For agenda, YouTube, and Zoom links, please visit www.suttonma.org/cable-department.

Present in person: W. Wence, M. McGovern, T. Thompson, J. Marran

Present in zoom: B. Faneuf -consultant

Unavailable: J. Duval

## Board Business

### Approve Minutes from 8/19/26 and 8/25/26

Motion: To approve the minutes from 8/19/26 and 8/25/26 T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson – yes, J. Marran- yes

## Certificates of Compliance

None

## Extension Requests

None

## Emergency Certifications

None

## Project/Site Visit Updates

### 135 Dodge Hill Rd – Field Change R. Mankaryous

B. Faneuf met R. Mankaryous on site for proposed minor field change to include 5 trees, 3 shrubs and boulders in place of cultecs. B. Faneuf recommends minor field change.

Motion: Issue minor field change -T. Thompson

2nd: J. Marran

Vote: 3-0-0, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson – yes, J. Marran- yes

W. Wence-recused

## Enforcement Issues:

**72 Main Street-** B. Faneuf, E/O kept alive to work w/Douglas if needed.

**320 Putnam Hill Road-** J. Marran, waiting on them to notify us to inspect.

**126 Burbank Road-** W. Wence sent email w/you tube video date/time of J. Lenihan agreeing to no home building until road completed. J. Marran-recused

## Correspondence of Interest:

**Forest Management Plan – 40 Wheelock Rd-** no comments

**MassDOT Invasives Management – Route 146 & M Route W.** Wence read in description of work. B. Faneuf blanket exemption to manage basic vegetation in right of way but are required to notify towns in which work is taking place.

Motion to adjourn: T. Thompson

2nd: M. McGovern

Vote: 4-0-0, W. Wence-yes, M. McGovern-yes, T. Thompson – yes, J. Marran

Adjourned: 6:11pm
